description: This file defines a utility function 'truncateSlackText' that trims a string to a maximum length with special handling for small max values.

methods.name: export function truncateSlackText(value: string, max: number): string { truncateSlackText
methods.description: Trims the input string 'value' to a maximum length 'max'. If the trimmed length is less than or equal to 'max', returns the trimmed string. If 'max' is less than or equal to 1, slices the trimmed string to 'max' characters. Otherwise, slices the string to 'max - 1' characters and appends an ellipsis.
